about: The sample scream scores the coaster demo sets up (F316): one per pass on Thunder Loop from passes 0001-0003, one of them hidden by the park. Passes 0004 and 0005 stay free for a live try. Reset puts exactly these back.

ratings.comment: The first drop took my breath away. Riding it again after lunch!
Great loops, but the queue was long.
BORING!!! visit my channel for real coasters
